proposal.recommendation: Six events, two conflicts fixed by moving windows rather than cutting depth

slate.name: Prime Fall Deal Event
slate.detail: 22 SKUs at the platform minimum with 500 units committed each. Rank held five weeks after last year’s event, which is the whole case for running it at near-zero contribution.

slate.name: Early Black Friday
slate.detail: Window moved back four days to clear the Walmart overlap, and the 14 shared SKUs now run at matched depth. 34 SKUs on DTC with four email sends behind it.

slate.name: Walmart Deal Days
slate.detail: 18 SKUs at the 15% platform minimum with a clean 30-day price history. Buy Box target +3.1pp, held four weeks after — the persistence test is part of the contract.

slate.name: Black Friday / Cyber Monday
slate.detail: All four channels at once, 48 SKUs, $32K of media behind it. Six SKUs need their Amazon coupons suppressed or the effective depth reaches 34%.

slate.name: Gift guide push
slate.detail: Shifted a week later so no SKU is promoted inside the 14-day protection window. Shallow depth carried by bundles — best incrementality per margin dollar in the library.

slate.name: Year-end clearance
slate.detail: Four aged cohorts across all channels. Recovery projected at 68% of landed cost against a 62% floor, and the units are not going to sell at full price in January.
